% Derived from the local PGF arrows.meta implementation: a reversed Latex
% tip has a different line end from a forward Latex tip.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[thick,arrows={{Latex[scale=.5]}-}] (0,0) -- (4,0);
  \draw[thick,-{Latex[scale=.5]}] (0,-0.8) -- (4,-0.8);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
